uncited: The algorithm advances analytically from one cell boundary to the next, avoiding fixed-distance sampling steps [S5, S7, unofficial].
**Time Delta ($t_{\Delta}$):** Calculate the time to travel one voxel unit along each axis.
**Initial Sample:** Sample the voxel at $(X, Y, Z)$.
*   **Time Complexity:** $O(N)$ where $N$ is the number of voxels traversed along the ray.
*   **Memory Complexity:** $O(W \times H \times D)$ for the dense voxel grid.
